# Reality-Constrained Plan

The light is broad, but the vessel must be real: inspect first, then reuse the architecture already proven.

## Phase A — Archaeology

- Map source, tools, tests, renderers, persistence, preview, export, scene schemas, and current proofs.
- Run baseline focused tests and inspect failures.
- Locate existing demo/movie generators before creating new modules.

## Phase B — Implementation

- Build or complete a one-minute sitcom project through existing scene/project contracts.
- Add only missing bridges, consumers, serializers, render paths, or tests.
- Rewrite complete files only; split touched JavaScript above 120 lines.

## Phase C — Verification

- Focused tests, full verify, browser production render, four scale courts, representative story frames, export, hashes, persistence reload, and compliance.
